manifest.name: dsh-assist
manifest.description: Portable personas, private memory, and opt-in idle chat for DeepSeek Harness Desktop.

bundle.text:
# Standard Harness bundle; installed through the host plugin manager.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-assist
      name: 'dsh-assist'

declared.name: assist_use
declared.description: Bind this session to a role; use only after an explicit user request.

declared.name: assist_memory_read
declared.description: Read current-role memories and this session’s checkpoint.

declared.name: assist_remember
declared.description: Store a meaningful fact, preference, decision, or labeled inference.

declared.name: assist_checkpoint
declared.description: Save a checkpoint summary for this session only.

declared.name: assist_recall
declared.description: Search current-role long-term memory; an empty query returns recent entries.

declared.name: assist_resume
declared.description: Explicitly copy an unexpired checkpoint from another session with the same role.

declared.name: assist_revise
declared.description: Replace the text of an existing current-role memory without deleting it.

declared.name: assist_idle_start
declared.description: Explicitly opt in to idle follow-ups only at the user request. Remember this session opt-in for restart recovery.

declared.name: assist_idle_stop
declared.description: Stop idle follow-ups and forget the saved opt-in for this primary session.

declared.name: assist_idle_status
declared.description: Return the idle follow-up status for this primary agent.

readme.text: **Your AI companion, with reusable personas, memory, and opt-in proactive chat.** A community plugin for **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**. [](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1) [](LICENSE) [](docs/VERIFICATION.md) [English](#english) · [简体中文](#简体中文) · [Download](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1) · [Documentation](#documentation) ---

Turn a Harness conversation into a reusable AI companion: choose a persona, retain useful memories, and let it start a brief conversation after a period of inactivity.

> **Preview release.** Targets Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.3**. Offline tests pass. Windows Desktop installation/loading was verified for v0.3.0; v0.3.1 keeps the same runtime. Real-model proactive chat and the revised voice remain unverified. This is an independent community project, not an official DeepSeek product.

**A more natural voice for the default fish daughter.** Replies can end naturally, without a routine follow-up question or service menu. The persona uses fewer stock affectionate phrases and includes short dialogue examples. Opt-in idle chat and restart recovery from v0.3.0 remain available.

[Download the plugin](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1) · [Install and enable](docs/DESKTOP.md) · [Send trial feedback](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/issues/new?template=trial-feedback.md)

We are looking for early testers on **Windows + Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3**. Tell us where installation, activation, restart recovery, or stopping worked or failed. The [one-minute trial](docs/IDLE.md) helps collect reproducible results; model calls use your normal quota. No need to share private conversations or memory files.

| Capability | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Portable personas | Versioned JSON packs with identity, voice, greeting, and memory guidance |
| Persistent memory | Long-term notes shared within a persona; short-term checkpoints scoped to a session |
| Proactive chat | Opt-in idle triggers with cooldowns, quiet hours, and an unanswered-message limit |
| Shareable packs | Public exports omit stored memories; private backups require an explicit option |
| Inspectable data | Local JSON storage, CLI tools, and documented formats |

**Rice-Loving Chubby Fish Daughter** — **爱吃白饭的大肥鱼女儿** — is a playful fictional fish who loves a bowl of plain steamed rice. She calls you “爸爸” (“Dad”) by default; you can change that address at any time. The bundled persona speaks Chinese by default; ask for another language if preferred.

> “Dad, I'm here.”

Her voice is meant to be brief and conversational: no routine follow-up questions or service menus, and no obligatory rice jokes or affectionate catchphrases. Questions are welcome when the conversation actually needs one. The examples guide the tone; they are not fixed replies.

**Availability:** The v0.3.1 downloads include the updated persona, selected automatically when initializing fresh storage. Existing installations retain their saved roles and memories; see [how to try the updated persona](docs/DESKTOP.md#默认角色与已有安装).

**Role ID:** `little-fish` · **Definition:** [packs/fish.json](packs/fish.json)
Get the files from the [v0.3.1 release](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1).

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/download/v0.3.1/dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz) | Desktop plugin installer — do not extract |
| [dsh-assist-0.3.1-source.zip](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/download/v0.3.1/dsh-assist-0.3.1-source.zip) | Complete source for development |
| [SHA-256 manifest](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/download/v0.3.1/dsh-assist-0.3.1-manifest.json) | Verify downloaded artifacts |
The commands below use **Windows PowerShell**. Desktop supplies its own runtime; a separate system Node.js/npm installation is not required for plugin installation.

1. Launch Harness Desktop once to initialize its profile. Use **Manage dsh Command…** in the application menu to install or repair its `dsh` command.
2. **Fully quit Desktop.** Closing the window may only hide it.
3. Open a new PowerShell terminal. Verify that `dsh` comes from Desktop and reports `0.2.1-rc.3`, then install the downloaded package:

```powershell
Get-Command dsh
dsh --version

$package = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz'

Adjust the path if your download is elsewhere. Stop if a command fails. Reopen Desktop after installation.

An npm-installed standalone `dsh` cannot modify Desktop's profile. See the [installation and troubleshooting guide](docs/DESKTOP.md) for source-folder installation and existing-user migration.

In the target conversation, ask:

> Use `assist_list`, select `little-fish` with `assist_use`, and read `assist_memory_read`. Then call `assist_idle_start`: chat after 15 idle minutes, wait at least 30 minutes between triggers, pause after two unanswered triggers, and stay quiet from 23:00 to 08:00.

**Enabled means the tool returned `enabled: true`**, not merely that the model said it would remind you.

| Action | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Enable or change settings | `assist_idle_start` |
| Inspect this conversation | `assist_idle_status` |
| Stop future triggers | `assist_idle_stop` |

Quiet hours use the backend's local timezone. The backend must remain running; saved opt-ins resume when the original session is loaded after restart, after a fresh idle/cooldown wait. New sessions stay off. Stop also forgets the saved opt-in. Each trigger uses the selected model and incurs normal usage. Stop does not retract a turn already submitted.

For a one-minute check, use `idleMinutes: 1`, `cooldownMinutes: 1`, `maxUnanswered: 1`, `quietStart: 0`, and `quietEnd: 0`. After the model finishes replying, stop typing. A trigger should occur after roughly 60–75 seconds; the response itself also depends on model latency. No second trigger should occur until you reply. Then call `assist_idle_stop`.

See [idle-chat settings](docs/IDLE.md) for full behavior. Reading [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) in TRAE or another tool does not, by itself, supply a running Harness timer. This package does not connect to QQ, WeChat, or X.

Memory lives in `DSH_ASSIST_HOME`, otherwise `DSH_HOME/dsh-assist`, or `~/.dsh/dsh-assist` when neither variable is set. Public export filters stored memory fields; it does not redact personal information written into the persona itself.

Standalone CLI and development require **Node.js 20.18+**. Core and CLI need no third-party runtime dependencies.

```powershell
node src/cli.js init --home "$PWD\.work\demo"
npm test
npm run check
npm run release
The release script builds local artifacts only. It does not publish to GitHub or npm.

This README is bilingual. The detailed guides are currently in Simplified Chinese.

[Installation & troubleshooting](docs/DESKTOP.md) · [Proactive chat](docs/IDLE.md) · [Persona format](docs/PACKS.md) · [CLI reference](docs/CLI.md) · [Verification scope](docs/VERIFICATION.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

为 Harness 聊天加入可复用的人设、持续保存的记忆，以及无人回复时主动聊一句的能力。

> **当前为预发布版。** 面向 Harness Desktop **0.2.1-rc.3**，离线验证通过；Windows 桌面端安装、加载已在 v0.3.0 验证，v0.3.1 沿用相同运行时代码。真实模型主动聊天及新版口吻尚未实测。本项目是独立社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。

**默认小鱼说话更自然。** 允许一句话自然结束，不固定追加反问或服务菜单，减少模板撒娇，并加入简短口吻示范。继续保留 v0.3.0 的主动聊天与重启恢复功能，仍需先在目标会话明确开启。

[下载安装包](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1) · [安装与开启步骤](docs/DESKTOP.md) · [反馈试用结果](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/issues/new?template=trial-feedback.md)

正在寻找使用 **Windows + Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.3** 的早期测试者：安装、首次开启、重启恢复、停止，在哪一步成功或遇到问题都可以反馈。[一分钟试用步骤](docs/IDLE.md)方便复现，模型调用会消耗正常用量；无需提供私人聊天和记忆文件。

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 可移植人设 | 用版本化 JSON 封装身份、说话风格、开场白和记忆规则 |
| 持久记忆 | 长期记忆按角色共享，短期摘要按会话保存 |
| 主动聊天 | 显式开启后按空闲时间触发，支持冷却、安静时段和无人回应上限 |
| 角色分享 | 公开导出不含已存记忆，私人备份需要明确选择 |
| 可检查数据 | 本地 JSON 存储，配套 CLI 和格式文档 |

readme.section: 默认角色：爱吃白饭的大肥鱼女儿
readme.text:
她圆滚滚、俏皮、有自己的小主意，喜欢捧着小饭碗吃热乎乎的白饭。示例默认称呼你“爸爸”，可以随时要求更改称呼。

> “爸爸，我来啦。”

日常可以简短自然地结束，不固定追加追问或服务菜单，也不每轮堆砌撒娇、称呼和白饭梗；话题确实需要时仍可提问。示范只用于引导语气，不是固定回复。

**使用范围：** v0.3.1 下载包已包含新版人设，全新存储首次初始化时自动使用。已有安装仍保留保存过的角色和记忆，试用方式见[默认角色与已有安装](docs/DESKTOP.md#默认角色与已有安装)。

**角色 ID：** `little-fish` · **人设文件：** [packs/fish.json](packs/fish.json)

在 [v0.3.1 发布页](https://github.com/a740411040/dsh-assist/releases/tag/v0.3.1) 下载：

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz` | 普通用户安装插件，无需解压 |
| `dsh-assist-0.3.1-source.zip` | 完整开发源码 |
| `dsh-assist-0.3.1-manifest.json` | SHA-256 校验清单 |

以下为 **Windows PowerShell** 步骤。桌面端自带运行环境，安装插件无需另行安装系统 Node.js/npm。

1. 先启动一次 Harness Desktop，完成 profile 初始化；在应用菜单的 **Manage dsh Command…** 中安装或修复桌面端命令。
2. **完全退出桌面端**，只关闭窗口可能仍在后台运行。
3. 打开新 PowerShell，确认 `dsh` 来自桌面端且版本为 `0.2.1-rc.3`，再安装：

```powershell
Get-Command dsh
dsh --version

$package = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'Downloads\dsh-assist-0.3.1.tgz'

下载到其他位置时修改路径；命令报错时先处理错误。确认安装后重新打开应用。
不要使用全局 npm 安装的另一个 `dsh` 修改 desktop profile。

源码目录安装、已有用户切换人设和故障排查见 [安装指南](docs/DESKTOP.md)。

readme.section: 开启、查询与关闭主动聊天
readme.text:
在目标会话中发送：

> 请先调用 assist_list，用 assist_use 切换到 little-fish，再调用 assist_memory_read。
> 然后调用 assist_idle_start：空闲 15 分钟后主动聊天，两次至少间隔 30 分钟，连续两次没人回复就暂停，23:00–08:00 不打扰。

**只有工具返回 `enabled: true` 才算开启**，模型口头说“已开启”不代表计时器已经运行。

| 操作 | 工具 |
| --- | --- |
| 开启或修改设置 | `assist_idle_start` |
| 查询当前会话 | `assist_idle_status` |
| 停止未来触发 | `assist_idle_stop` |

安静时段按后端本地时区计算。**应用后端必须保持运行**；已启用的原会话重新加载后会恢复，重新等待空闲与冷却；新会话仍需首次启用。停止会同时删除保存的启用状态。每次触发产生正常模型用量，停止不会撤回已提交的回合。

readme.section: 开启、查询与关闭主动聊天
readme.text:
一分钟体验可设为 `idleMinutes: 1`、`cooldownMinutes: 1`、`maxUnanswered: 1`、`quietStart: 0`、`quietEnd: 0`。等回复完成后停止输入，约 60–75 秒应触发一个模型回合，实际回复还取决于模型速度。你再次回复前不应有第二次触发；体验后调用 `assist_idle_stop`。

完整参数见 [主动聊天说明](docs/IDLE.md)。只让 TRAE 等工具读取 [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)，不会自动获得 Harness 计时与唤醒能力。本包不连接 QQ、微信或 X。

记忆优先存放在 `DSH_ASSIST_HOME`，其次为 `DSH_HOME/dsh-assist`，均未设置时使用 `~/.dsh/dsh-assist`。公开导出会过滤已存记忆，但不会自动脱敏人设正文中的个人信息。

独立 CLI 和开发需要 **Node.js 20.18+**，核心与 CLI 无第三方运行依赖：

```powershell
node src/cli.js init --home "$PWD\.work\demo"
npm test
npm run check
npm run release

发布脚本仅生成本地产物，不自动上传 GitHub 或 npm。
